rationale.conceptual: The method involves a custom algebraic derivation for dissociation degrees (Eqs. 1-16) that is not a textbook standard. Implementing it requires understanding the physical context and correctly translating the paper's multi-component equations into code, including solving a nonlinear relation for αk and handling edge cases. This is more than a trivial formula, but the equations are fully given, so it is an established but non-trivial documented algorithm.
rationale.execution: The pipeline consists of two simple sequential stages (equilibrium constant calculation and table generation). Both can be done in a single script with standard math libraries. No external tooling, data fetching, or complex orchestration is needed. The main challenge is careful implementation of the algebraic relations and root-finding.
